dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL); uses LINE SEQUENTIAL organization, no COMP-3, no EXEC SQL/CICS, standard COBOL-85 constructs including 88-level condition names, OCCURS, REDEFINES, INDEXED BY, and SORT/MERGE verbs
evidence: SORT SORT-FILE ON ASCENDING KEY ... USING ... GIVING

purpose.domain_detail: Medicine/pharmaceutical warehouse inventory management - sorting and merging warehouse product records from three warehouse files (NV10, CA20, WA30) and producing a sales/inventory report
purpose.summary: This program sorts three unsorted warehouse data files by warehouse ID and vendor ID, merges them into a single file, performs multi-level control breaks (warehouse, vendor, product), validates data, does vendor table lookups, accumulates totals at product/vendor/warehouse/grand-total levels, and outputs a formatted inventory report. Bad warehouse records are written to an error file.

notable_features: MERGE of multiple files into SD file
Table search with INDEXED BY and OCCURS
Error record accumulation and separate error file output
Multiple output headers and detail lines with edited PIC clauses
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
